summary: 本期收录1条通过核验的新闻。
highlights: 高负载全固态锂硫电池正极报告近15 mAh cm−2面容量

articles.event_key: 全固态锂硫电池|界面设计实现高负载|全固态锂硫电池
articles.title: 高负载全固态锂硫电池正极报告近15 mAh cm−2面容量
articles.summary: 《Nature Materials》论文报告通过硫–硫化物和硫–碳界面调控，实现高负载全固态锂硫电池正极，面容量接近15 mAh cm−2，并给出超过500 Wh kg−1的软包电池能量密度预测。
articles.new_facts: 本期首次收录：界面调控使全固态锂硫电池正极面容量接近15 mAh cm−2、硫利用率超过90%，并给出500 Wh kg−1级软包电池预测。
entities: 全固态锂硫电池（All-solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries）
硫–硫化物/硫–碳界面（sulfur–sulfide and sulfur–carbon interfaces）
articles.limitations: 论文摘要只给出关键性能，未提供完整实验条件；500 Wh kg−1为基于正极数据的软包电池推算值，不是独立实测的商用电池结果。

facts.text: 《Nature Materials》11月20日在线发表的研究称，研究团队通过让硫–硫化物界面发生部分锂化、并消除硫–碳界面的电子阻挡氧化层，制备出高负载全固态锂硫电池正极。论文报告的面容量接近15 mAh cm−2，硫利用率超过90%，测试时的堆叠压力为15–25 MPa。

evidence.quote: By enabling partial lithiation at the sulfur–sulfide interface and eliminating the electron-impeding oxidation layer at the sulfur–carbon interface

facts.text: 论文将这些正极指标折算为软包电池层面超过500 Wh kg−1的能量密度预测，并报告1C倍率下循环500次保持82.1%容量、库仑效率最高99.9%；使用锂金属负极时，在10 MPa而不是常见的锂–铟合金条件下也能稳定循环。

evidence.quote: projected pouch-cell-level energy densities surpassing 500 Wh kg
Fast cycling at 1C retains 82.1% capacity over 500 cycles
stable cycling is also achieved with a lithium metal anode at 10 MPa

facts.text: 摘要给出的500 Wh kg−1是软包电池层面的推算值，论文报告的是正极面容量和循环数据；摘要称该工作展示了通过复合正极界面控制设计高能量密度全固态电池的途径。

evidence.quote: This work highlights the power of interfacial control within composite cathodes
demonstrates another approach for designing high-energy-density all-solid-state

bilingual.title_en: High-Loading All-Solid-State Lithium–Sulfur Cathode Reports Nearly 15 mAh cm−2 Areal Capacity

sentences.en: A study published online in Nature Materials on November 20 reported that the research team fabricated a high-loading all-solid-state lithium–sulfur battery cathode by partially lithiating the sulfur–sulfide interface and eliminating the electron-blocking oxide layer at the sulfur–carbon interface.
sentences.zh: 《Nature Materials》11月20日在线发表的研究称，研究团队通过让硫–硫化物界面发生部分锂化、并消除硫–碳界面的电子阻挡氧化层，制备出高负载全固态锂硫电池正极。

sentences.en: The paper reported an areal capacity approaching 15 mAh cm−2, a sulfur utilization exceeding 90%, and a stack pressure of 15–25 MPa during testing.
sentences.zh: 论文报告的面容量接近15 mAh cm−2，硫利用率超过90%，测试时的堆叠压力为15–25 MPa。

sentences.en: The paper converted these cathode metrics into a projected energy density exceeding 500 Wh kg−1 at the pouch-cell level and reported 82.1% capacity retention after 500 cycles at 1C, with Coulombic efficiency up to 99.9%; when a lithium-metal anode was used, stable cycling was also achieved at 10 MPa rather than under the commonly used lithium–indium alloy condition.
sentences.zh: 论文将这些正极指标折算为软包电池层面超过500 Wh kg−1的能量密度预测，并报告1C倍率下循环500次保持82.1%容量、库仑效率最高99.9%；使用锂金属负极时，在10 MPa而不是常见的锂–铟合金条件下也能稳定循环。

sentences.en: The 500 Wh kg−1 given in the abstract is a projected value at the pouch-cell level, while the paper reports cathode areal capacity and cycling data; the abstract states that this work demonstrates a route to designing high-energy-density all-solid-state batteries through interfacial control in composite cathodes.
sentences.zh: 摘要给出的500 Wh kg−1是软包电池层面的推算值，论文报告的是正极面容量和循环数据；摘要称该工作展示了通过复合正极界面控制设计高能量密度全固态电池的途径。
